principle: Download or register authoritative source material once, preserve original/provenance, decompose it into typed knowledge objects, then build relations. Tasks and model training remain downstream consumers of this graph.

for_every_document: preserve ORIGINAL with source URI, acquisition time, media type and SHA-256
extract title, issuer/author, publication/version/effective dates and status
create stable CHUNK objects with location anchors
extract conditions, exceptions, prohibitions, permissions and recommendations
extract named entities: standards, languages, algorithms, data structures, artifacts, roles, controls, metrics
extract examples and counterexamples separately from normative statements
assign source class and trust dimensions
create GAP when exact text, currentness, applicability or evidence is unavailable

minimum_relation_examples: TASK -TEACHES-> KNOWLEDGE_NODE only after PROGRAMMING_KB MIN gate

source_to_kb_node: applicability is explicit for normative statements
